management_steps.details: Muscarinic (DUMBELS): Diaphoresis, Urination, Miosis, Bradycardia/bronchorrhoea, Emesis, Lacrimation, Salivation. Nicotinic: Fasciculations, weakness, HT, tachycardia, mydriasis. CNS: seizures, coma.
Universal precautions. Remove clothing, wash skin with soap and water. If intubation required, avoid succinylcholine (causes prolonged paralysis).
Atropine 0.04-0.05 mg/kg IV stat (3-5mg adult). Double every 5 mins until atropinised. Infusion: 200mg Atropine in 200ml saline (1mg/ml), run at 10-20% of total dose already given/hr.
Benzodiazepines only for seizures (No phenytoin). Monitor and correct electrolytes. Weakness (nicotinic symptom) may require prolonged intubation.

warnings: Thrombolytic / Antidote Endpoint: CLEARING OF RESPIRATORY SECRETIONS (Atropinisation), NOT tachycardia or pupil size.
